checks.audio: Whisper small.en captured the A/B/C labels and all exact bodies in both modalities. Independent Vosk confirmed all three distinct response bodies in order. No promotion based on nonspecific word matches.
checks.association: Exact SHA-bound formal and practice WAVs, separate throughout with original accent and roles per mode, dialogue keyed to the same written options. Kept original number cue audio and scored answer window; exact offline structural/timing validation only.
